Get how much each information criterion improves as a class or a group class is added

Source: R/wildcards.R
get_deltas.Rd

get_deltas() returns, for every candidate of a profile or class grid, how much lower its information criterion is than that of the candidate with one profile fewer, and than that of the candidate with one group class fewer. The criterion is bic_groups, BIC with the number of groups as the sample size.

Usage

get_deltas(x)

Arguments

x

A profile or class grid from enumerate_lpa(), enumerate_lca() or enumerate_classes(). Transition grids, grids of group-class families and regression grids have no such table and are refused.

Value

A data frame with one row per candidate and the columns:

  • candidate, n_profiles, n_group_classes, model: the candidate, its numbers of classes and its covariance structure;

  • criterion: the name of the criterion, bic_groups;

  • value: the candidate's value of the criterion;

  • delta_profile: the criterion of the candidate with one profile fewer (and the same group classes and structure) minus value. A positive number means that this candidate is lower;

  • from_profile: the name of that smaller candidate;

  • delta_group_class, from_group_class: the same for the candidate with one group class fewer.

A delta is NA where there is no such smaller candidate, or where either of the two did not converge.

Errors: latents_bad_argument for a transition, family or regression grid, naming the tables it has; latents_not_a_fit when x is not an enumeration grid.

See also

plot_deltas() draws the changes; get_knees(), get_best().

Examples

grid <- enumerate_lpa(faithful, c("eruptions", "waiting"),
                      n_profiles = 1:3, model = "EEI",
                      n_starts = 2, seed = 1)
get_deltas(grid)
#>   candidate n_profiles n_group_classes model  criterion    value delta_profile
#> 1 profiles1          1               1   EEI bic_groups 3055.835            NA
#> 2 profiles2          2               1   EEI bic_groups 2354.601     701.23422
#> 3 profiles3          3               1   EEI bic_groups 2322.969      31.63182
#>   from_profile delta_group_class from_group_class
#> 1         <NA>                NA             <NA>
#> 2    profiles1                NA             <NA>
#> 3    profiles2                NA             <NA>
